title: Unable to position game window correctly on multi-monitor setup with different resolutions
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot 4.5.1 stable on Windows 11
Not reproducible in Godot 3.6 stable on Windows 11

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6641) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 31.73 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have two monitors of different resolutions, and after creating a bare project, setting the position of the window gives strange results, .e.g. strange positions and scaling levels.  It seems to depend on the position as to what the results are, and I believe Godot is getting confused with its calculations when the position moves the window onto the second monitor.

It may be related to these issues?:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/56341
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112854

### Steps to reproduce

I have two monitors:-
* Main at res 3840x2160, 250% zoom (origin)
* Second monitor to the right, at res 1920x1080

1. Create a new project and add a single Node2D.
2. In project settings, set the "Initial Position Type" to "Absolute".
3. Add a script and add a single line of code `get_window().position = Vector2(4000, 0)`
4. Run the project NOT in the embedded window
5. The window appears in the top-middle of my first monitor.

Depending on what value I set as the X value in that line, I get different results:-

- If X is 3000, it positions correctly (and slight intrudes onto the second monitor) and is the correct size
- If X is 4000, it positions in the middle of the first monitor, and it's size seems to be reduced by 250%
- If X is 7000, the window is nowhere to be seen.
- I cannot seem to get it to appear entirely on the second monitor, no matter what values I try.
